name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (1963–1966)
description: A blue field with a yellow five-pointed star in the upper hoist and a red diagonal band edged in yellow running from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Adopted in 1963, replacing the six-star flag of independence: the single yellow star was moved to the upper hoist and a red band bordered in yellow was laid diagonally across the field. It was slightly modified in 1966 after Joseph-Désiré Mobutu's rise to power.
